name: default-skills
description: Pins chosen skills (ponytail, feature-based-architecture and its own plain-writing by default) into the system prompt every session, so they are on from the start and survive compaction.

skills.title: Skills to pin
skills.description: Comma-separated, each as plugin:skill or skill, optionally followed by its arguments (e.g. `ponytail:ponytail full, my-style`). Each skill's text is sent with every turn.
